feedback: T2 explanation misses reference ideas term frequency, inverse document frequency, logarithm, and rare words weighted higher. T3 code uses CountVectorizer instead of the TfidfVectorizer matrix X and prints the wrong numeric output.

justification.code: Code mark 4: T1 is correct with intended method and output; T2 is essentially correct (right shape) but uses a non-intended alias and no print statement; T3 is wrong (uses CountVectorizer instead of TfidfVectorizer on X, produces wrong output 6 instead of 0.6344).
justification.explanation: Explanation mark 4: T2 explanation is partly correct but generic, shallow, and misses all reference ideas (term frequency, inverse document frequency, logarithm, common words down-weighted, rare words weighted higher); T3 explanation is mostly correct and covers the reference ideas in own words.
justification.documentation: Documentation mark 3: Good docstring on the tokenize helper and a meaningful comment on the vocabulary update; minor gap that the T2/T3 cells have only one trivial comment and no docstrings.
